Chapter 7001: Great Immortal

Chapter 7001: Great Immortal

“Destroyer of Breaker?” Mo Xiangsheng had heard of this story. However, it became a different version after being passed around so many times.

The first time he heard this, he considered it to be an unrealistic legend. Now, the legend stood before him. This was someone who could slay celestial immortals, an overlord such as himself was nothing.

“I was blind, now it is time for consequences.” Till Ancestor took a deep breath.

“What consequence?” Li Qiye smiled.

“I have nothing to say since I am weaker, do as you please.” Till Ancestor responded.

“Should I kill you or just flay you?” Li Qiye smiled.

Mo Xiangsheng opened his mouth but didn’t say anything. He had asked Li Qiye to show mercy once already.

“Either way, the victor decides.” Till Ancestor didn’t ask for mercy.

“Are you not afraid of death?” Li Qiye asked.

“Everyone is afraid of death, immortals included. However, there are things more precious than life.” Till Ancestor said.

“Well said, but I don’t have a reason to take your life since it has no value to me.” Li Qiye smiled, catching Till Ancestor off guard.

Although Li Qiye’s words were insulting, this was indeed the truth. Although Till Ancestor didn’t appreciate the insult, there was nothing he could do about it.

“Nice, Senior, hurry up and thank the immortal.” Mo Xiangsheng came over and whispered.

“What do you want?” Till Ancestor carried himself with dignity on top of being stubborn, unable to curry favor.

“Sit down and drink tea.” Li Qiye tapped the table.

Till Ancestor and Mo Xiangsheng exchanged awkward glances before sitting down. Ye Fantian also poured tea for them.

“The source will really stay here?” Till Ancestor drank his cup before asking.

“It belongs to this world, so it shall stay here to nourish the inhabitants.” Li Qiye said.

“What about us?” Mo Xiangsheng became bolder.

“Your punishment shall be to stay here and guard it.” Li Qiye said.

“Stay here? This is a punishment?” He was surprised to hear it.

Although this was a punishment, staying here meant being nourished by the celestial source. This was extremely beneficial for cultivators.

“Should I bury you here instead?” Li Qiye smirked.

“No, no. I’ll guard this place with my life.” He shuddered.

“Now that’s what I like to hear.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I am speaking from the heart, thank you for this gift, Immortal.” He said shamelessly while prostrating.

“Thank you, Young Noble.” On the other hand, Till Ancestor’s skin wasn’t as thick so he only bowed slightly.

Li Qiye accepted the gesture. Alas, his tea time was interrupted by lightning bolts flashing in Heaven Pit. The other two couldn’t spot this.

Till Ancestor noticed the pause and asked: “What is it, Young Noble?”

“Protect this place, I’ll be back.” He stood up and disappeared from sight.

“Senior, what’s going on?” Mo Xiangsheng asked.

“I don’t know, must be something major.” Till Ancestor said. Only something monumental could move such a monster to action.

“You didn’t see the direction?” Mo Xiangsheng asked.

“Did you?” Till Ancestor glared at him.

“Haha, my cultivation is too shallow, but you’re an immortal.” Mo Xiangsheng stuck out his tongue.

“Hmph.” Till Ancestor snorted in response.
